# itch.io asset sources

## Currently shown in the game

- Cryo's Mini GUI: minimap frame.
- Cat User Interface: portrait beside the hearts.
- Raven Fantasy Icons: five card-set icons.

## Downloaded UI sources

### UI User Interface MEGA PACK — ToffeeCraft
- Source: https://toffeecraft.itch.io/ui-user-interface-mega-pack
- Files used: `Resources/ItchUI/fantasy_panel.png`
- Free license: personal use and game development; commercial use requires the paid license.
- Changes: cropped from `freefantasy.png` and imported as a sliced Unity UI sprite.

### Cat User Interface — ToffeeCraft
- Source: https://toffeecraft.itch.io/cat-user-interface
- Files used: `Resources/ItchUI/cat_portrait.png`
- License: personal and commercial use allowed; modification allowed; standalone redistribution forbidden.
- Changes: cropped from `free.png`.

### Gamepad UI / Controller Prompts Pack — greatdocbrown
- Source: https://greatdocbrown.itch.io/gamepad-ui
- Files used: `Resources/ItchUI/keycap.png`
- License: Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal (CC0).
- Changes: one blank keycap cropped from `gdb-keyboard-2.png`.

### Raven Fantasy Icons — Clockwork Raven
- Source: https://clockworkraven.itch.io/raven-fantasy-icons
- Files used: `Resources/ItchUI/SetIcons/*.png`
- License: personal and commercial projects allowed; modification allowed; standalone redistribution forbidden; attribution optional.
- Changes: selected icons renamed for the five card sets.

## Release warning

The current UI uses one personal-use-only ToffeeCraft fantasy panel. Buy the paid license or replace that panel before a commercial release.

### Free Pixel Climbing plants pack 32x64 — Danaida
- Source: https://danaida.itch.io/free-pixel-climbing-plants-pack-32x64
- Files used: `Resources/WorldProps/Vines/liana_2.png`, `liana_7.png`, `liana_5.png`, `liana_4.png`
- Use: room seal walls (green on horizontal stages, red on vertical stages).
- License: commercial and personal use allowed; free to edit; do not redistribute or resell the assets.
